description: Claude Code adapter — haiku, sonnet, opus; fable for escalation tiers only.

cheap.notes: Trivial read-only utility work — Scoot's tier. Split out from sonnet so cheap is a genuinely cheaper rung (haiku/sonnet/opus ladder).

standard.notes: Analyst, Spellwright, Mechanic first pass. Also the Systemsmith's first crack at build work (Robin, 2026-09-16); a bounce escalates the fixer, not the reviewer.

strong.notes: Architecture, critique, frontend/backend first pass. Also the cold reviewer's tier (roles.delegate.cold_reviewer.tier).

frontier.notes: Fable re-enabled for escalation (Jul 2026). Reached by the escalation ladder's second rung (second_challenger_rejection -> escalated), the Counselor's standing default, an active experiment, or an explicit human ask. Not a review-gate default: cold reviewers run on a capable tier in a fresh context, and escalate only on a demonstrated miss (Robin, 2026-09-16). No effort parameter on this runtime: request extended thinking in the spawn prompt (e.g. think hard).

escalated.notes: Fable — repeated failure, hard adjudication, human-requested escalation. No effort parameter on this runtime: the conductor MUST raise effort via the spawn prompt (ultrathink / extended-thinking directive) and allow a larger revision budget; that is the highest-reasoning mechanism on Claude.
